plan.notes: MERGE NOTE: total_credits=121 = the official checksheet as printed (15+17+16+15+15+15+13+15=121), which exceeds the catalog's stated 120 minimum. Plan kept at the checksheet's own total so the validator's exact-sum check passes. Source: official UVM 2025-2026 B.S. Computer Science checksheet (published by UVM, references the 2025-2026 Catalogue at catalogue.uvm.edu), transcribed course-by-course from the checksheet's official 8-semester sequence. Program is housed in the College of Engineering and Mathematical Sciences (CEMS). True degree name per catalogue.uvm.edu: 'Computer Science B.S.CS.' (Bachelor of Science in Computer Science). Catalog publishes a minimum of 120 credits; the checksheet's stated term totals are 15+17+16+15+15+15+13+15 = 121, so total_credits is 121 to match the transcribed sequence exactly. Checksheet year-2 note: CS 2210 Computer Organization and Catamount Core (SU Sustainability) are swappable between Fall and Spring of Year 2; transcribed as CS 2210 in Fall Y2 and SU Sustainability in Spring Y2 (first-presented arrangement). Prereq or-alternatives from the checksheet not encoded as hard prereqs: CS 1640 also accepts CS 2100 (instead of CS 1210) and MATH 1242 (instead of MATH 1234); STAT 2430 also accepts MATH 1224; STAT 2510 also accepts MATH 1242; CS 2250 also accepts MATH 2055 (instead of CS 1640); CS 3240 'Recommended: CS 2250; STAT 2430 or STAT 2510' is advisory only. Checksheet: C- or higher required in CS 1210 and CS 2100. Math elective slot: choose one of MATH 2248 Calculus III, MATH 2522 Applied Linear Algebra, MATH 2544 Linear Algebra, MATH 2678 Basic Combinatorial Theory, or MATH 3201 Advanced Engineering Mathematics (3-4 cr each; transcribed at 3). Natural Science slot Y1S2 (3 cr, non-lab) + Y2S1 'Natural Science w/ Lab' (4 cr) satisfy the catalogue's 7-credit natural science rule (2 courses from ASTR/BIOL/BCOR/CHEM/GEOL/PHYS/PBIO, one a 4-credit lab). Capstone: checksheet says 'refer to degree audit for options'; not enumerated here to avoid inventing options. No term-by-term plan exists at catalogue.uvm.edu itself (catalogue is requirement-list only); the checksheet is the only official UVM term-by-term sequence.
